definitions.gloss: Japanese tea (typically green tea); Japanese-style green tea
definitions.explanation: Tea produced and prepared in the Japanese style — almost always green tea ({緑茶|りょくちゃ}), in contrast to Chinese tea ({中国茶|ちゅうごくちゃ}) or black tea ({紅茶|こうちゃ}).

examples.japanese: {日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{発酵|はっこう}→発酵：13605_hakkou⟧⟦させない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Unlike black tea, Japanese tea is not fermented.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧な{日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new stylish Japanese tea café has opened in front of the station.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (Japan) + ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea). The word marks tea as Japanese-style in contrast to other tea traditions; in everyday speech among Japanese speakers, plain ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧ usually already means this.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{淹|い}れる→淹れる：13297_ireru⟧: to brew Japanese tea
- {日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: Japanese tea café
- {日本茶|にほんちゃ}⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: specialty Japanese tea shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧: green tea — the type; nearly all {日本茶|にほんちゃ} is ⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧
- ⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧: black tea — contrasted with {日本茶|にほんちゃ}
- {中国茶|ちゅうごくちゃ}: Chinese tea — contrasted with {日本茶|にほんちゃ}
- ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧: tea (general) — in domestic contexts usually refers to {日本茶|にほんちゃ} by default
